correctness.rationale: The standalone script exhausts 331 nonempty simplices and proves acyclicity of a 160-pair matching. Its exact ±1 integer cancellations yield 5+5 critical cycles with zero Morse boundary; the lift/projection maps are checked. It computes all 120 S5 actions on these integral bases. A five-orbit degree-two matrix has determinant -1; the degree-three invariant-line orbit has Smith diagonal (1,1,1,1,3), proving its index. Critical group actions satisfy Coxeter relations and all 120 integer traces match prior rational characters; no finite-field inference.

originality.rationale: The exact new invariants are integral S5 module matrices, a unimodular signed five-point orbit basis in degree two, and an intrinsic index-three orbit sublattice in degree three. The known wedge and rational characters do not imply the lattice structure; primary same-graph sources classify edge matchings or automorphisms without computing integral homology action. Targeted actual published and database searches found no covering statement, with unindexed equivalence and partial full-text access residual risks.

value.rationale: For the canonical S5-symmetric Petersen graph, integral module structures are intrinsic new invariants beyond rational Betti numbers or rational characters. The primitive degree-two signed permutation lattice and degree-three order-three orbit quotient reveal a strong degree-dependent modular symmetry obstruction; complete integer generator matrices and orbit representatives make these facts useful in modular and equivariant topology.
